phase_1.title: baseline freeze
phase_1.description: Use TASK-1024 baseline as frozen snapshot. Existing drift is classified as baseline state. No new or modified drift allowed beyond baseline.

phase_2.title: strict on new or modified
phase_2.description: Existing drift must be remediated or covered by waiver with expires_at. New or modified violations are blocking. Expired waivers are blocking.

phase_3.title: full repo strict enforcement
phase_3.description: Strict enforcement applies repo-wide; no baseline allowance. NOT in v3.5.0 scope. Activation is data-driven after v3.5.0.

gates.title: Source/template exact-sync gate (baseline-aware)
gates.rationale: FIND-29 source/template sync fragility. Baseline-aware enforcement uses TASK-1024 baseline_existing classification.
gates.behavior: For each pair in baseline.source_template_pairs: recompute sha256 of source and template; (a) if current=in_sync, pass; (b) if baseline declared drift/missing AND current sha unchanged from baseline, pass with reason_code=baseline_existing; (c) if drift after baseline change without waiver, fail; (d) if covered by valid unexpired waiver, skipped_with_reason_code.

gates.title: JSON schema / structure validation
gates.rationale: FIND-31 multi-model style and behavior drift. Minimal v3.5.0 bootstrap structural gate; not a universal JSON Schema framework.
gates.behavior: Parse JSON; verify required schema_version literal; verify required top-level keys present.

gates.title: Import-time side-effect gate
gates.rationale: FIND-31 multi-model style and behavior drift. v3.4 TASK-1013 validate_context_stack import-side-effect fix established precedent.
gates.behavior: For each candidate in baseline.import_side_effect_surface (candidate_for_import_side_effect_gate=true): subprocess import with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 + PYTHONUTF8=1 + PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1; capture stdout/stderr/exit_code. If module is in expected_import_clean list and not clean -> fail. Else advisory+record (first-cycle observation; no enforcement yet).

gates.title: Golden CLI output harness bootstrap
gates.rationale: FIND-31 multi-model style and behavior drift. Bootstrap harness only; full golden coverage deferred.
gates.behavior: Validate each candidate's capture_policy = 'post_task_evidence_only'. Do not execute --help commands (would create __pycache__). Report skipped_with_reason_code unless unsafe capture_policy is detected.

advisory_gates.title: ruff format + lint (advisory only in v3.5.0)
advisory_gates.rationale: Multi-model style baseline. v3.5.0 keeps ruff non-blocking for first cycle to avoid false drift fights with downstream forks.
advisory_gates.behavior: Detect ruff config presence (ruff.toml / .ruff.toml / pyproject.toml). Do NOT invoke ruff. Always emit status=advisory.

deferred_gates.name: PCACC
deferred_gates.description: Pre-Commit Cross-Artifact Consistency Check (4 strict structural checks).

deferred_gates.name: Artifact Obligation Matrix
deferred_gates.description: Presence-only matrix of required/optional/forbidden artifacts per task type.

deferred_gates.name: validator module split
deferred_gates.blocked_by: v3.5.x characterization tests + gates green for at least one release cycle

deferred_gates.name: policy registry extraction
deferred_gates.description: Extract policy constants from workflow_constants.py into a separate registry.

deferred_gates.name: full repo strict enforcement (Phase 3)
deferred_gates.description: Repo-wide strict enforcement with no baseline allowance.

rules: All six required fields must be present.
expires_at MUST NOT appear alone; missing peer fields make the waiver invalid.
owner MUST reference a human reviewer or accountable maintainer (not an AI agent label).
evidence_ref MUST point to a verify artifact path under artifacts/verify/.
expires_at MUST be enforceable: TASK-1025 gates MUST reject expired waivers as blocking.
scope MUST be a non-empty list of repo-relative paths.
Date format: YYYY-MM-DD; expiration check uses lexicographic comparison against Asia/Taipei date.

discovery.rationale: v3.5.0 forbids a global waiver registry. Waivers live alongside the artifact they cover OR are recorded explicitly in this policy's waivers array.

limitations: Waiver discovery uses the explicit waivers array in this policy. Full decision-artifact waiver discovery (scanning artifacts/decisions/ for waiver blocks) is conservative-deferred; missing decision-side waivers will not be auto-recognized in v3.5.0.

QC-IMPORT-001 first cycle treats unlisted candidates as advisory; only modules listed in expected_import_clean are blocking. This is a baseline-aware bootstrap stance to avoid TASK-1025 self-check failing on pre-existing module-level state of unaudited candidates.
QC-GOLDEN-001 does not execute CLI --help commands to avoid creating __pycache__. Output capture is post_task_evidence_only and belongs to a future task.
QC-RUFF-001 does not invoke ruff. v3.5.0 keeps ruff non-blocking; advisory-only.
Phase 3 full repo strict enforcement is NOT in v3.5.0 scope. Activation is data-driven after v3.5.0.
PCACC and Artifact Obligation Matrix are deferred to TASK-1026 and TASK-1027 respectively.
Validator module split (FIND-30) and policy registry extraction are deferred to v3.5.1 / v3.6.
TASK-1025 does NOT remediate baseline drift (QB-DRIFT-0001..0003). Drift remediation belongs to a future task lifecycle with explicit decision artifact authorization.
